name: Kepler-560B
description: Star bound to Kepler-560, 4,569 AU away.

radius.source: Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the radius of TIC 239275856 (VizieR IV/39/tic82)

mass.source: Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the mass of TIC 239275856 (VizieR IV/39/tic82)

temperature.source: Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the effective temperature of TIC 239275856 (VizieR IV/39/tic82)

text.card: Kepler-560B is a star of 3,545 K, bound to Kepler-560 4,569 AU away.
text.introduction: Kepler-560B shares its motion through space with Kepler-560, 4,569 AU away, so the two are a bound pair. Both are placed where Gaia measures them.

notes: Kepler-560B's orbit around Kepler-560 is not measured; both stars are placed at their Gaia DR3 positions, which is where they are
